title: WGPU Standard Effects Conformance Harness Follow-on v1
problem: Several standard effect and postprocess WGPU conformance tests still duplicated the same Rgba8Unorm final-render readback helpers already owned by the shared integration-test support module. The duplication obscured the behavior evidence for effect contracts without adding coverage.

repro.summary: Standard effect and postprocess WGPU conformance tests should render and sample through shared test support while preserving Rgba8Unorm transparent-clear behavior.
commands: cargo nextest run -p fret-render-wgpu --locked --test effect_alpha_threshold_conformance --test effect_color_matrix_conformance --test effect_filter_content_blur_conformance --test effect_filter_content_blur_rounded_clip_conformance --test effect_filter_content_dither_conformance --test effect_filter_content_noise_conformance --test effect_filter_content_pixelate_conformance --test effect_filter_content_pixelate_rounded_clip_conformance --test postprocess_scissor_conformance -j 1

gates.name: standard-effects-conformance
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-render-wgpu --locked --test effect_alpha_threshold_conformance --test effect_color_matrix_conformance --test effect_filter_content_blur_conformance --test effect_filter_content_blur_rounded_clip_conformance --test effect_filter_content_dither_conformance --test effect_filter_content_noise_conformance --test effect_filter_content_pixelate_conformance --test effect_filter_content_pixelate_rounded_clip_conformance --test postprocess_scissor_conformance -j 1

continue_policy.notes: The named standard effect/postprocess tests migrated successfully. Backdrop, custom, warp-v2, drop-shadow, image, text, viewport metadata, Vulkan, and MSAA helper cleanup should stay in separate one-family follow-ons because their target setup or semantics may differ.
